dedupe_keys.name: istanbul zeytinburnu regional seismic fragility loss and resilience from physics based ground motions

description: This dataset holds the results of a regional seismic risk study of more than 16,000 reinforced concrete buildings in the Zeytinburnu district of Istanbul, using ground motions from 57 physics-based fault-rupture and wave propagation simulations. It was published on DesignSafe-CI in 2023 by Wenyang Zhang, Ertugrul Taciroglu, Peng-Yu Chen and Kuanshi Zhong. For each building and scenario, site-specific simulated motions drove three-dimensional nonlinear time-history analyses; peak storey drift ratios and floor accelerations were then used for building-specific fragility of structural and nonstructural components, FEMA P-58 loss assessment with Monte Carlo simulation, and recovery-time resilience measures, each with and without soil-structure interaction. Coverage: the Zeytinburnu district of Istanbul. Access: DesignSafe Data Depot, project PRJ-3829. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): ODC-By-1.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: the file list was not read, and results depend on the simulated fault scenarios and building models. Simulation uses: regional earthquake loss and recovery estimates and testing the effect of soil-structure interaction at city scale. Related records: pelicun, R2D and the Pohang piloti building dataset.
